caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wooden bar interior with an elaborate mirrored back and detailed woodwork in dark brown tones. The bar counter is lined with various bottles, including green, brown, and clear glass bottles, some with labels visible. Behind the counter are multiple shelves filled with more bottles arranged in rows, glasses, and other barware, as well as a silver or metallic drinks fountain or dispenser. At the center of the back bar, there are three large beer pumps with ornate gold accents and handles. Above the bar, two large, elaborate chandeliers with gold frames and six white glass globes each hang from the ceiling. The backdrop and side panels feature mirrors bordered by woodwork and stained-glass panels with geometric designs in muted reds, yellows, and blues. The wall behind the bar is dark green and decorated with a pattern of clusters of purple grapes and grapevines, interspersed with nude or partially-draped human figures in various reclining and standing poses, rendered in pale flesh tones. Four sculpted figures, painted in pink and red hues, stand on either end of the wooden bar structure, two on each side, integrated into the woodwork. The overall color palette includes rich browns, gold, dark green, purple, muted reds, and pale flesh tones.
title: Bar
